MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

 Load Diffusion Model

Download minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors19.5 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/h3

Create the h3 folder if it does not exist. This is the Reference to Video version of MiniMax H3 (ref2va), the one that can look at pictures and videos you give it.

READ LICENSE More versions 

 Load CLIP

Download qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors14.6 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

Qwen3-VL 32B reads your prompt AND looks at your pictures and video. It works on any recent NVIDIA card, not only the newest.

 Load VAE (video and sound)

Download minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors2.6 GB  

Download minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors577 MB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/vae

 The int8 video VAE is about twice as fast as the older fp16 one and looks the same. The fp16 one from earlier episodes still works if you already have it.

 LoRA (in LoRA Loader Pixaroma)

The Open H3 Regenerate 2K LoRA, by NVIDIA (Efficient-Large-Model), in the ComfyUI version made by DrakenZA. Download the swiglu_fixed file, not the other one with a similar name.

Download open_h3_regenerate_2k_comfy_swiglu_fixed.safetensors8.8 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/loras/h3

Create the h3 folder inside loras if it does not exist.

NVIDIA's page and licence DrakenZA's ComfyUI version 

 Latent upscale model (in H3 Latent Upscale Pixaroma)

The H3 latent upscale model by LBH-123-AI (Apache-2.0).

Download minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1_fp16.safetensors691 MB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/latent_upscale_models

 After placing the files, restart ComfyUI or refresh model lists using the R shortcut.

 Nodes Installed from Manager

  • Pixaroma, version 1.4.239 or newer. A node shows red or missing? Update Pixaroma.

Which version is the newest? The Latest Pixaroma version button shows it and what is new in it. The help page has the update steps for every kind of install.

Latest Pixaroma version How to update Pixaroma 

 Something missing?

Each button opens a short video that shows the fix, with the steps written under it.

Red or missing nodes A model file is missing Buttons missing after an update 

 Resources

Join Discord  Pixaroma YouTube Channel  Ask for help

{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

Remakes a small or soft video in 2K, 1440 x 2560 (or Full HD): every frame is redrawn with new detail in the face, the hair and the clothes. The moves, the framing and the sound stay.

 Steps

  1. 1. Pick how many seconds (the length of your video).
  2. 2. Load your video, for example a 480 x 864 result from another workflow.
  3. 3. Pick the new size: 1440 x 2560 (2K) or 1088 x 1920 (Full HD). A landscape video needs the switch on Landscape.
  4. 4. Pick the denoise (see below).
  5. 5. Describe your video in one or two plain sentences.
  6. 6. Seed: F (fixed) or R (random).
  7. Press Run.

 Denoise: more detail or closer to your video

  • 0.5 (the default): lots of new detail in the hair, the face and the clothes. Small things can change: on two of three photo-real faces in the tests the eye colour turned brown, and writing the eye colour in the prompt did not help.
  • 0.3: for a person, or anything that must stay as it is. About half as much new detail as 0.5, but in the test the blue eyes stayed blue.
  • 0.4: in between (in the test the eyes still turned brown).
  • 0.6: the setting closest to NVIDIA's own recipe. More detail; the face changes more (in the test: deeper lines, darker eyebrows).
  • 0.75: the most detail, but H3 redraws so much that the person changes (in the test his blue eyes turned brown and his hair darker) and the mouth follows the words less closely.
  • Use the buttons. With only 3 steps, a number between two buttons gives the same video as one of them.

 Good to know

  • The moves, the framing and the timing stay, because H3 starts from your video. Your video's own sound is locked into the render, so the mouth keeps moving with the words (in the talking test, at 0.4 to 0.6 the mouth followed your video almost exactly).
  • Next to workflow 10 (Sharpen + Full HD): more detail, and 2K. It is still a new video, though: very close to yours, but every frame is redrawn. Workflow 10 keeps the face closest of all, so use it when the face must not change at all.
  • Describe your video in plain words in step 5: who, what they wear, what they do, where. H3 redraws every frame with it.
  • Another seed gives another take. The higher the denoise, the more the face can change.
  • The LoRA is NVIDIA's open version of MiniMax's paid Regenerate to 2K. H3 Latent Upscale Pixaroma is a port of LBH-123-AI's H3 latent upscaler (MIT licence), so no extra node pack is needed.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Nodes look different from the video

widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (MiniMax H3 ref2va) - MiniMax H3, the video model: the same ref2va file as in the other H3 workflows. Here it redraws your video with the Regenerate LoRA.
  • Load CLIP (Qwen3-VL, reads prompt and pictures) - Qwen3-VL 32B: reads your prompt.
  • Load VAE (video) - Turns the finished render into video frames, and your video into the model's own format.
  • Load VAE (sound) - Turns sound into the model's format and back.
  • LoRA Loader Pixaroma (Regenerate 2K) - Holds the Open H3 Regenerate 2K LoRA, ON at 1. It already has a speed LoRA and a sharpness LoRA inside, so nothing else goes here.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Duration Pixaroma (1. how many seconds) - How many seconds of your video to remake, turned into the frame count H3 accepts.
  • Load Video Pixaroma (2. your video) - Your video, for example a 480 x 864 result from another workflow. Its sound goes into the render and into the saved video.
  • Sizes Pixaroma (3. new size) - The size of the new video: 1440 x 2560 (2K) or 1088 x 1920 (Full HD, about twice as fast). The Portrait / Landscape switch must match your video: a landscape video needs Landscape.
  • Number Pick Pixaroma (4. denoise, more detail or closer) - The denoise: how much of every frame H3 may redraw. Higher = more new detail, but more of your video changes. 0.5 (the default) adds a lot of detail; 0.3 keeps a person closest; 0.75 changes the person.
  • Prompt Pixaroma (5. describe your video) - A plain description of what is in your video: who, what they wear, what they do, where, the light. H3 redraws every frame, and this keeps it on the same person and place.
  • Seed Pixaroma (6. random or fixed) - The seed. F (fixed) gives the same result every Run, R (random) a new one each Run.

 The helpers

Purple. They run by themselves and do the small jobs: count, pick, join or pass things along.

  • Longest Side Pixaroma (draft size, leave it) - Brings your video to 1024 on its longest side (576 x 1024 for a 9:16 video), the draft size the Regenerate recipe starts from. Leave it as it is.

 Working in the background

Teal. They run by themselves: they make the steps faster, hand memory back, lock the real sound into the render or guide the moves. The line next to each one says if there is anything worth changing.

  • MiniMaxH3SigmaShift (6 / 3 for the regenerate pass) - The noise schedule of the regenerate pass: 6 for the picture, the value NVIDIA's own recipe uses, and 3 for the sound. Leave it as it is.
  • Model Attention Backend (faster steps) - Picks the attention maths. comfy kitchen attention makes each step about 1.7 times faster on NVIDIA and AMD cards with the same look (measured). If you get an error with it, pick pytorch attention.
  • H3 Audio Sync Pixaroma (your video's sound in the render) - Locks your video's REAL sound into the render, so the mouth keeps moving with the words while every frame is redrawn.
  • Free VRAM Pixaroma (before the decode) - Hands the graphics card's memory back between the render and the video decode, so the decode fits on smaller cards.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • VAE Encode (your video to latent) - Turns the draft-size video into H3's own format.
  • H3 Latent Upscale Pixaroma (to the new size) - Enlarges the video inside H3's own format to the new size with a trained upscale model, without decoding it first. The model file goes in ComfyUI/models/latent_upscale_models.
  • MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo (reads the prompt) - Reads your prompt for the render, at the new size and length.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (empty negative) - An empty negative prompt. H3 runs at CFG 1 here, where the negative does nothing, but the KSampler still needs one plugged in.
  • KSampler (3 steps, denoise from Number Pick) - The render: 3 steps, CFG 1, euler, simple, the settings of the Regenerate recipe. Its denoise comes from Number Pick Pixaroma.
  • VAE Decode (render to video frames) - Turns the finished render into video frames.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Video Pixaroma (the 2K video) - Saves the new video as MP4 into ComfyUI/output/Regenerate 2K with your video's own sound, and plays it on the node.
  • Image Compare Pixaroma (first frame, before and after) - The FIRST FRAME of your video (1) and of the new one (2) on top of each other. Drag across it to compare.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Nodes Info","icon":"node-v5","color":"#3d7cc9"}}

widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the size and with the seconds.

New size5 seconds
1440 x 2560 (2K), the defaultabout 4 to 5 min (250 to 300 s)
1088 x 1920 (Full HD)about 2 min (115 s)

Times are with comfy kitchen attention (the default here). With pytorch attention the render part takes about 1.7 times as long.

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models (about 20 GB for H3 and 15 GB for its text encoder), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.

 On a smaller card

Start with the smallest size and 5 seconds. The Free VRAM node already hands memory back before the video decode. A clip that is too big for the card gets very slow long before it stops working.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Run Times","icon":"run-timer","color":"#3f9a4f"}}
